name: EU Lower Exposure Action Value (LEX,8h)
source: Directive 2003/10/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 6 February 2003 on the minimum health and safety requirements regarding the exposure of workers to the risks arising from physical agents (noise), Article 3(1)(c): lower exposure action values LEX,8h = 80 dB(A) and ppeak = 112 Pa (135.0 dB(C) re 20 uPa, via 20*log10(112 / 20e-6)); Article 2 defines ppeak as the maximum 'C'-frequency weighted instantaneous noise pressure. Official Journal L 42, 15.2.2003, p. 38-44.

name: EU Upper Exposure Action Value (LEX,8h)
source: Directive 2003/10/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 6 February 2003 on the minimum health and safety requirements regarding the exposure of workers to the risks arising from physical agents (noise), Article 3(1)(b): upper exposure action values LEX,8h = 85 dB(A) and ppeak = 140 Pa (136.9 dB(C) re 20 uPa, via 20*log10(140 / 20e-6)); Article 2 defines ppeak as the maximum 'C'-frequency weighted instantaneous noise pressure. Official Journal L 42, 15.2.2003, p. 38-44.
